# StackedAreaChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders multiple nonnegative series as cumulative stacked area bands.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new StackedAreaChart(options?: StackedAreaChartOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`curve`](#curve): Curve interpolation mode for stacked area boundaries.
- [`defaultFillOpacity`](#defaultfillopacity): Default fill opacity for stacked area bands (`0..1`).
- [`defaultLineWidth`](#defaultlinewidth): Default stroke width for upper boundary lines in points.
- [`mode`](#mode): Stacking mode: `absolute` (default) or 100% normalized `percent`.
